lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a grid-like formation posterior to the five vertical gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots to form visible anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin displays a high-density distribution of high-luminance spots, and a small teleost fish is visible in the water column immediately ventral to the pectoral fin.
